Clipster | Remote (UTC+2) | Full-Time

Clipster is where brands and creators connect to turn views into profits. We help creators earn through performance-based content and enable brands to scale organic content marketing with measurable results.

We launched our platform in early 2025 and have since grown to 35 team members, 80,000+ active users, and $3.8M+ in payouts. We’ve acquired 120+ clients fully organically through word of mouth.

Our clients and partners include Telegram, UFC, Universal Music Group, and artists like Elton John, Ed Sheeran, Playboi Carti, and Kendrick Lamar.

We’re profitable, growing fast, and backed by our first investor.

We’re hiring:

Engineering Manager — $84k+ annual Looking for someone with a strong engineering background, people management experience, and hands-on knowledge of Go / Golang. Stack: Golang, Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, GCP.

Senior Product Manager — $72k–96k annual Own key product areas, work closely with the founder, and help shape product strategy in a fast-moving startup environment. Looking for 5+ years in Product Management and strong ownership.

Product Designer — $48k–72k annual Design core product experiences for creators and brands, from flows and wireframes to polished UI. Looking for 3–5 years in Product Design, strong Figma skills, and startup-style ownership.

Founding Sales Lead — $36k–72k annual Own inbound sales, build pipeline in HubSpot, run outbound, and help create the sales process from scratch. Looking for someone with 3–6 years in sales and strong closing skills.

General requirements: strong English and availability to work with CET overlap.
